summary: East kerb lined with houses 3-9 m away along its length.

best_section.where: East kerb of Almeida Street, mid-block near the first garages

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 3-9 m from the kerb at every point along the line; front yards face the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars park along the east side so there is kerbside room.
drivers.convention: Residents park here, but only directly outside homes.

sun_shade: Mostly open; street trees give patchy shade.
